cases.prompt: Write a Selenide Java test for logging in.
expectations: Uses open() and $ selectors with setValue and click.
Uses shouldBe or shouldHave conditions which wait automatically.
Configures Selenide via Configuration (browser, baseUrl) instead of creating a WebDriver by hand.

cases.prompt: With Selenide, how do I assert the search results list has 5 items, each containing "phone"?
expectations: Checks each item contains the text, for example with a collection condition or loop of shouldHave(text(...)).
